f.title: Submit Art. 30 notifications through VigiMed
f.statement: Holders (DRM) shall send the notifications covered by Art. 30 of RDC 406/2020 through Anvisa's electronic notification system, VigiMed.
f.clause: Art. 1, new wording of RDC 406/2020 Art. 26 §1
f.applicability: Wording of RDC 406/2020 as amended by RDC 967/2025 (published D.O.U. 20/03/2025; Art. 2: in force 365 days after publication, i.e. about 20 March 2026).
f.change_summary: New wording of RDC 406 Art. 26 §1 naming VigiMed as the electronic notification system for Art. 30 notifications. The pre-amendment 2020 wording is not in the captured texts, so the exact difference from the original RDC 406 text is not verified here.
f.predecessor_note: Same obligation as ANVISA-RDC-406-2020-0036 in the previous version.

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (Detentor de Registro de Medicamento, DRM)
rows.quote:
§ 1º Os Detentores de Registro de Medicamento (DRM) deverão encaminhar as notificações objeto do art. 30 desta
 Resolução por meio do sistema eletrônico de Notificação disponibilizado pela Anvisa - o VigiMed.
rows.location: Art. 1, new wording of RDC 406/2020 Art. 26 §1
rows.change_note: New wording of RDC 406 Art. 26 §1 naming VigiMed as the electronic notification system for Art. 30 notifications. The pre-amendment 2020 wording is not in the captured texts, so the exact difference from the original RDC 406 text is not verified here.
rows.review_note: Review: no change; previous_key checked: points to the RDC 406 row for Art. 26 caput/§1. In force 365 days after publication (D.O.U. 20/03/2025), i.e. 20 March 2026. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: quote matches text; "deverão encaminhar" = Mandatory; actor DRM explicit; removed the parenthetical describing Art. 30 from the statement (Art. 30 is not in this text). Translation verified: quote_en faithful in meaning, modal force, numbers and actor.
rows.quote_en: § 1 Holders of Registration of Medicines (DRM) shall send the notifications covered by Art. 30 of this Resolution through the electronic Notification system made available by Anvisa - VigiMed.

f.title: Send notifications through VigiMed per ICH E2B(R3), manually or by XML import
f.statement: Holders shall send notifications to the SNVS through VigiMed in accordance with the ICH E2B(R3) standard requirements. They may use the VigiMed manual interface or import compatible XML files, grouped or individual, generated in their own computerised PV systems.
f.clause: Art. 1, new wording of RDC 406/2020 Art. 26 §2
f.applicability: Wording of RDC 406/2020 as amended by RDC 967/2025 (published D.O.U. 20/03/2025; Art. 2: in force 365 days after publication, i.e. about 20 March 2026).
f.exceptions: Either the manual interface or XML file import (grouped or individual) may be used.
f.change_summary: New wording of RDC 406 Art. 26 §2: notifications go to the SNVS through VigiMed according to ICH E2B(R3), by manual entry or XML import (grouped or individual) from the holder's own PV system. The pre-amendment 2020 wording is not in the captured texts, so the exact difference from the original RDC 406 text is not verified here.
f.predecessor_note: Same obligation as ANVISA-RDC-406-2020-0037 in the previous version.

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (Detentor de Registro de Medicamento, DRM)
rows.quote:
§ 2º Os Detentores de Registro de Medicamento deverão enviar as notificações ao Sistema Nacional de Vigilância
 Sanitária (SNVS) por meio do sistema VigiMed, de acordo com os requisitos definidos pelo padrão E2B(R3) do
 International Council for Harmonisation of Technical Requirements for Pharmaceuticals for Human Use (ICH), podendo
 ser utilizada a interface manual ou de importação de arquivos em formato XML compatíveis, de forma agrupada ou
 mesmo individual, gerados em seus próprios sistemas informatizados de Farmacovigilância, para fins de cumprimento
 do disposto no caput deste artigo.
rows.location: Art. 1, new wording of RDC 406/2020 Art. 26 §2
rows.change_note: New wording of RDC 406 Art. 26 §2: notifications go to the SNVS through VigiMed according to ICH E2B(R3), by manual entry or XML import (grouped or individual) from the holder's own PV system. The pre-amendment 2020 wording is not in the captured texts, so the exact difference from the original RDC 406 text is not verified here.
rows.review_note: Review: no change; previous_key checked: points to the RDC 406 row for Art. 26 §2. "deverão enviar" Mandatory; "podendo ser utilizada" permission kept in exceptions. In force 365 days after publication (D.O.U. 20/03/2025), i.e. 20 March 2026. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: quote matches text; "deverão enviar" = Mandatory, "podendo ser utilizada" permission correctly in exceptions; actor explicit. Translation verified: quote_en faithful in meaning, modal force, numbers and actor.
rows.quote_en: § 2 Holders of Registration of Medicines shall send the notifications to the National Health Surveillance System (SNVS) through the VigiMed system, in accordance with the requirements defined by the E2B(R3) standard of the International Council for Harmonisation of Technical Requirements for Pharmaceuticals for Human Use (ICH); the manual interface or the import of files in compatible XML format, grouped or even individual, generated in their own computerised Pharmacovigilance systems, may be used, for the purpose of complying with the caput of this article.

f.title: Follow the regional ICH E2B(R3) specifications in the VigiMed Empresas manual and XML instructions
f.statement: The regional specifications for the ICH E2B(R3) guideline that apply to notifications sent through VigiMed are set out in the VigiMed Empresas User Manual and the Instructions for Creating ICH E2B XML Files, published on the Anvisa portal.
f.applicability: Wording of RDC 406/2020 as amended by RDC 967/2025 (published D.O.U. 20/03/2025; Art. 2: in force 365 days after publication, i.e. about 20 March 2026).
f.change_summary: New paragraph §3 added to RDC 406 Art. 26 (shown as 'Incluído pela RDC nº 967' in the compiled RDC 406 text): points to the VigiMed Empresas User Manual and ICH E2B XML instructions as the Brazilian regional E2B(R3) specifications.
f.predecessor_note: Same obligation as ANVISA-RDC-406-2020-0073 in the previous version.

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (Detentor de Registro de Medicamento, DRM)
rows.quote:
§ 3º As especificações regionais para o Guia do ICH E2B(R3) encontram-se dispostas no Manual de Uso do VigiMed
 Empresas e nas Instruções para a Criação de Arquivos XML ICH E2B, publicados no Portal da Anvisa.
rows.change_note: New paragraph §3 added to RDC 406 Art. 26 (shown as 'Incluído pela RDC nº 967' in the compiled RDC 406 text): points to the VigiMed Empresas User Manual and ICH E2B XML instructions as the Brazilian regional E2B(R3) specifications.
rows.review_note: Review: no change; previous_key checked: points to the RDC 406 row for Art. 26 §3. Art. 26 §3 has no modal verb ("encontram-se dispostas"); Mandatory by reference to the §2 E2B(R3) duty. In force 365 days after publication (D.O.U. 20/03/2025), i.e. 20 March 2026. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: quote matches; below 90: no modal verb ("encontram-se dispostas"), Mandatory and DRM actor inferred by reference to §2. Translation verified: quote_en faithful in meaning, modal force, numbers and actor.
rows.quote_en: § 3 The regional specifications for the ICH E2B(R3) Guideline are set out in the VigiMed Empresas User Manual and in the Instructions for Creating ICH E2B XML Files, published on the Anvisa Portal.

f.title: Code with MedDRA (medical terms, AEs) and WHODrug (medicines incl. vaccines)
f.statement: When sending reports and notifications to the SNVS, holders must use MedDRA to code medical terms and adverse events and the WHODrug dictionary to code medicines, including vaccines.
f.clause: Art. 1, new wording of RDC 406/2020 Art. 35
f.applicability: Reports and notifications sent to the SNVS. Wording of RDC 406/2020 as amended by RDC 967/2025 (published D.O.U. 20/03/2025; Art. 2: in force 365 days after publication, i.e. about 20 March 2026).
f.change_summary: New wording of RDC 406 Art. 35 requiring MedDRA for medical terms and adverse events and the WHODrug dictionary for medicines, including vaccines. The pre-amendment 2020 wording is not in the captured texts, so the exact difference from the original RDC 406 text is not verified here.
f.predecessor_note: Same obligation as ANVISA-RDC-406-2020-0052 in the previous version.

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (Detentor de Registro de Medicamento, DRM)
rows.quote:
Art. 35. No envio dos Relatórios e das Notificações ao SNVS, os Detentores de Registro de Medicamento devem
 utilizar o Dicionário Médico para Atividades Regulatórias (MedDRA) na codificação de termos médicos e de eventos
 adversos, e o Dicionário WHODrug na codificação de medicamentos, incluindo vacinas.
rows.location: Art. 1, new wording of RDC 406/2020 Art. 35
rows.change_note: New wording of RDC 406 Art. 35 requiring MedDRA for medical terms and adverse events and the WHODrug dictionary for medicines, including vaccines. The pre-amendment 2020 wording is not in the captured texts, so the exact difference from the original RDC 406 text is not verified here.
rows.review_note: Review: no change; previous_key checked: points to the RDC 406 row for Art. 35 caput. In force 365 days after publication (D.O.U. 20/03/2025), i.e. 20 March 2026. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: quote matches text; "devem utilizar" = Mandatory; actor DRM explicit; statement adds nothing. Translation verified: quote_en faithful in meaning, modal force, numbers and actor.
rows.quote_en: Art. 35. When sending Reports and Notifications to the SNVS, Holders of Registration of Medicines must use the Medical Dictionary for Regulatory Activities (MedDRA) for coding medical terms and adverse events, and the WHODrug Dictionary for coding medicines, including vaccines.

f.title: Follow MedDRA supporting documents, the VigiMed Empresas manual and ICH E2B XML instructions
f.statement: Companies must follow the MedDRA supporting documents published on the MedDRA portal, and the VigiMed Empresas User Manual and Instructions for Creating ICH E2B XML Files, aligned with the UMC Technical Guide for use of WHODrug Global, published on the Anvisa portal.
f.clause: Art. 1, new RDC 406/2020 Art. 35 sole paragraph
f.applicability: Wording of RDC 406/2020 as amended by RDC 967/2025 (published D.O.U. 20/03/2025; Art. 2: in force 365 days after publication, i.e. about 20 March 2026).
f.systems: MedDRA; WHODrug; VigiMed; ICH E2B XML
f.change_summary: New sole paragraph added to RDC 406 Art. 35 (shown as 'Incluído pela RDC nº 967' in the compiled RDC 406 text): companies must follow MedDRA supporting documents and the VigiMed Empresas manual and E2B XML instructions aligned with the UMC WHODrug Global technical guide.
f.predecessor_note: Same obligation as ANVISA-RDC-406-2020-0053 in the previous version.

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (Detentor de Registro de Medicamento, DRM)
rows.quote:
Parágrafo único. As empresas
 devem seguir os documentos de suporte de uso do MedDRA, publicados no Portal do MedDRA, e o Manual de Uso do
 VigiMed Empresas e as Instruções para a Criação de Arquivos XML ICH E2B, alinhados com o Guia Técnico para uso
 do WHODrug Global do Uppsala Monitoring Centre (UMC), centro colaborador da Organização Mundial da Saúde
 (OMS), publicados no Portal da Anvisa.
rows.location: Art. 1, new RDC 406/2020 Art. 35 sole paragraph
rows.change_note: New sole paragraph added to RDC 406 Art. 35 (shown as 'Incluído pela RDC nº 967' in the compiled RDC 406 text): companies must follow MedDRA supporting documents and the VigiMed Empresas manual and E2B XML instructions aligned with the UMC WHODrug Global technical guide.
rows.review_note: Review: no change; previous_key checked: points to the RDC 406 row for Art. 35 sole paragraph. In force 365 days after publication (D.O.U. 20/03/2025), i.e. 20 March 2026. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: quote matches text; "devem seguir" = Mandatory; actor "as empresas" explicit (DRM in context); statement adds nothing. Translation verified: quote_en faithful in meaning, modal force, numbers and actor.
rows.quote_en: Sole paragraph. Companies must follow the MedDRA supporting documents published on the MedDRA Portal, and the VigiMed Empresas User Manual and the Instructions for Creating ICH E2B XML Files, aligned with the Technical Guide for the use of WHODrug Global of the Uppsala Monitoring Centre (UMC), a collaborating centre of the World Health Organization (WHO), published on the Anvisa Portal.
